svg.aria-label: A cross-section of an underground mine: the main fan runs at full duty and pushes air to every level, idle headings included, while diesel exhaust hangs at the working face, a blast gas cloud keeps a crew waiting, the deepest face runs hot, the energy meter is high and the planner and the ventilation room hold a model that does not match the mine
svg.title: The pain: air goes where nobody works and too little reaches where people do
